tools.description: Runs a bounded Python snippet against the bundled generated Python SDK client in a separate interpreter under an operating-system sandbox (a Windows AppContainer with no network capability inside a Job Object, or Linux bubblewrap); the isolated child has no direct network and its SDK requests are forwarded to the server, which alone reaches the configured API host and holds the credentials. Enabled by default only when that isolation is available; otherwise it returns an execute_disabled refusal and OMNIWRAP_MCP_EXECUTE=enabled cannot bypass isolation. The names `client`, `sdk` and `tmp_path` are available; set `result` to a JSON value to return it.

code.description: Python source executed against the bundled SDK. Use the `client` object, write to files only under `tmp_path`, and assign a JSON-serializable value to `result`.

tools.name: execute
tools.title: Execute Python against the SDK

tools.description: Search contract-derived documentation for operations, parameters, schemas, error mappings, authentication schemes and SDK method names. Deterministic keyword ranking with bounded results.
